title: Integrated computational screening of FDA-approved anticancer drugs as novel HPV-16 E6 inhibitors in cervical cancer.
one_liner_zh: 该文用机器学习与分子对接筛选FDA抗癌药靶向HPV-16 E6蛋白，属于蛋白-小分子药物筛选，而非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合体系，方法可迁移性有限，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Cervical cancer, predominantly induced by high-risk human papillomavirus (HPV) strains, remains a significant global health burden despite advancements in cancer therapeutics. Among viral oncoproteins, the HPV-16 E6 protein plays a pivotal role in carcinogenesis by targeting tumor suppressor pathways, making it an attractive therapeutic target. This study introduces an integrated computational framework for systematically repurposing FDA-approved anticancer drugs as potential E6 inhibitors. A library of 100 anticancer drugs was screened using machine learning models, with Gradient Boosting achieving optimal predictive performance (MCC = 1.0, AUC = 1.0), identifying 21 promising candidates. Molecular docking analyses further prioritized five lead compounds-Axitinib, Cabozantinib, Tivozanib, Deflazacort, and Cilostazol-with strong binding affinities (-8.13 to -9.24 kcal/mol) to the E6 protein. Quantum chemical calculations provided insights into the electronic properties and structure-activity relationships of these compounds, underscoring their potential inhibitory mechanisms. This study highlights the power of machine learning-driven approaches in drug discovery. It identifies clinically approved candidates for further experimental validation as HPV-16 E6 inhibitors, paving the way for innovative therapeutic strategies in HPV-associated malignancies. However, as the findings are based on computational screening, further in vitro and in vivo validation is required to confirm the inhibitory potential of the identified compounds against HPV-16 E6.
abstract_zh: 宫颈癌主要由高危型人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）菌株诱发，尽管癌症治疗取得了进展，其仍是全球重大健康负担。在病毒癌蛋白中，HPV-16 E6蛋白通过靶向肿瘤抑制通路在癌变过程中发挥关键作用，使其成为有吸引力的治疗靶点。本研究引入了一个整合的计算框架，用于系统性地重新利用FDA批准的抗癌药物作为潜在的E6抑制剂。使用机器学习模型筛选了100种抗癌药物库，其中梯度提升（Gradient Boosting）实现了最佳预测性能（MCC = 1.0，AUC = 1.0），识别出21个有前景的候选药物。分子对接分析进一步优先筛选出五种先导化合物——阿昔替尼（Axitinib）、卡博替尼（Cabozantinib）、替沃扎尼（Tivozanib）、地夫可特（Deflazacort）和西洛他唑（Cilostazol）——它们与E6蛋白具有强结合亲和力（-8.13至-9.24 kcal/mol）。量子化学计算提供了这些化合物的电子性质和构效关系见解，强调了其潜在抑制机制。本研究凸显了机器学习驱动方法在药物发现中的力量。它识别出临床批准的候选药物，用于进一步实验验证作为HPV-16 E6抑制剂，为HPV相关恶性肿瘤的创新治疗策略铺平了道路。然而，由于研究结果基于计算筛选，需要进一步的体外和体内验证以确认所识别化合物对HPV-16 E6的抑制潜力。
